subject: Dedicated capacity: Add GPU nodes and throughput SLA — pricing options
messages:
From: Ciara O'Neill <ciara@falkonai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: add nodes + throughput guarantee for Q2 spike

Hi Neha,

Quick one — our SRE team is seeing a projected traffic spike in late Q2 (see attached sample), and we're exploring options to add dedicated capacity for peak inference. Two asks:

1) Can you give pricing for adding ~12 GPUs to our existing pool (mix of A100/H100 options)?
2) Can Redwood commit to a throughput/latency SLO for the expanded pool (we care about p99 latency for 1k concurrent connections)?

We may be open to a short-term uplift (4–6 months) or a longer commit if economics work. Can you loop in pricing and any discounts for mid-term commits or prepay?

Thanks,
Ciara
Ciara O'Neill
Head of SRE, FalkonAI
attachments: falkon_traffic_report_q1.csv

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ciara O'Neill <ciara@falkonai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add nodes + throughput guarantee for Q2 spike

Hi Ciara — thanks for the note and the sample traffic. High level options below; I attached a short cost comparison spreadsheet as well.

Option A — Short-term burst (4 months)
- Add 12x A100 (40GB) as burst-only nodes attached to your pool
- Estimated incremental monthly spend: $62,000/month
- No long-term commit required; 0% discount on list price
- Throughput guidance: p99 under typical QPS up to 1.2k connections; p99 latency target ~180–220ms depending on request size

Option B — Mid-term uplift (6 months reserved)
- Add 12x H100 equivalent nodes (or 16x T4-style lower-latency configs for throughput-first)
- Estimated incremental monthly spend: $48,500/month (amortized reserved rate)
- Standard mid-term uplift discount: 8% if you commit additional 6 months of reserved capacity
- Throughput SLO: p99 latency target <150ms for baseline model (we'll validate with your payloads)

Option C — 12-month committed expansion (preferred economic terms)
- Add 12 GPUs, 12-month reserved commit, ability to scale to +20 GPUs with 30-day notice
- Estimated effective monthly spend: $41,000/month (after committed discount)
- Discount: up to 12% with annual prepay
- SLA: 99.9% availability for reserved pool, p99 latency guarantees and prioritized scheduling

Notes / tradeoffs:
- Pricing varies by GPU type and exact model size; the attached cost-comparison shows H100 vs A100 vs mixed pools.
- We can provide a short validation run to confirm latency on your payloads before finalizing SLA.
- Attachments: cost-comparison-3pool.xlsx

Looping Rishi for commercial and Laura for approval on discounts — Rishi: do these discount bands look doable for FalkonAI?

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1-415-555-0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add nodes + throughput guarantee for Q2 spike

Neha — quick internal note.

- Option B (6 months) with an 8% uplift discount is within standard playbook for mid-term capacity increases, but we should confirm net-new ARR thresholds. If FalkonAI expands committed spend by >$200k ARR, we can consider 10%.
- For SLA language: we should avoid hard p99 latency liability without runbook / validation window. Propose: provisional p99 target in amendment, with final SLA subject to successful 7-day validation test.

Laura — approve 8% as baseline, 10% if they take 12-month prepay?

—Rishi
Business Development, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add nodes + throughput guarantee for Q2 spike

Agree with Rishi on validation-first approach.

- Approve 8% for 6-month mid-term uplift max.
- Approve up to 10% for 12-month prepay with signed amendment and legal sign-off.
- Legal needs to confirm language for SLA fallback (auto-fallback to best-effort without credit unless validation passed).

If Neha wants to offer 10% to close quickly, mark that for my verbal approval; I'll follow up in writing.

Laura Bennett
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ciara O'Neill <ciara@falkonai.com>, ops@falkonai.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-31T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add nodes + throughput guarantee for Q2 spike

Hi Ciara — thanks, we discussed internally and put three clean options in the attached amendment draft. Highlights:

- Option 1 (Burst): 12x A100 for 4 months, $62k/mo, no commit. No SLA guarantees beyond standard availability.
- Option 2 (Uplift): 12x H100-class for 6 months, $48.5k/mo, 8% mid-term uplift discount, provisional p99 target <150ms subject to validation run.
- Option 3 (Commit): 12x mixed nodes, 12-month commit, $41k/mo effective with annual prepay and 10% discount currently (we can push to 12% at exec approval if FalkonAI pre-pays 12 months). SLA: 99.9% availability for reserved pool + prioritized scheduling.

Attachments: proposed_amendment_draft.pdf (includes redlines, runbook steps for validation), cost-comparison-3pool.xlsx

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm preferred option and whether FalkonAI will prepay 12 months or sign 6-month uplift.
2) If you choose Option 2/3, we'll run a 7-day validation window (zero-cost) to confirm latency with your payloads; SLA becomes effective after validation success.
3) Legal and procurement contacts for FalkonAI so we can route the amendment.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through numbers.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_amendment_draft.pdf

From: Ciara O'Neill <ciara@falkonai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@falkonai.com
Date: 2027-04-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add nodes + throughput guarantee for Q2 spike

Thanks Neha — useful breakdown. A few quick follow-ups:

1) Procurement asks if we can get 12% off for full 12-month prepay instead of 10% (they're willing to prepay if economics are right).
2) Ops wants the validation window documented (start date, sample payloads, rollback plan).
3) Please include our procurement lead on the amendment: procurement@falkonai.com

I've attached the sample traffic you asked for earlier. If we can get 12% with 12-month prepay we can likely sign before EOW. Otherwise Option 2 (6-month uplift) is our fallback.

—Ciara
attachments: falkon_traffic_report_q1.csv

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Ciara O'Neill <ciara@falkonai.com>, procurement@falkonai.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: add nodes + throughput guarantee for Q2 spike — proposed concession

Hi Ciara / Procurement — appreciate the quick turnaround. Laura and Rishi approved escalation for a stronger commercial concession:

- Offer: 10% discount on the 12-month prepay (effective rate in Option 3) as an approved standard.
- Concession: We can make this 12% only if FalkonAI prepays the full 12 months AND signs an addendum that allows Redwood to publish aggregate, anonymized performance benchmarks (standard marketing clause).

If procurement is comfortable with the marketing clause we will route the final amendment to Legal and can have countersigned docs by EOW.

Validation window: We'll include a 7-day zero-cost runbook in the amendment. The SLA is contingent on successful completion. Failure to meet agreed p99 targets during validation results in a rollback option for FalkonAI to revert to previous capacity with pro-rated charges.

Next steps: add procurement@falkonai.com as signatory, confirm prepay, and I'll submit the amendment to Legal (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-FA-2027-03).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-415-555-0198
